title: Reminder: make the GitHub repo private
details: Ready: All rights reserved licence (PR #38 if not yet merged), board on Cloudflare at board.quando.day, Firebase App Distribution uploads private test builds. Before switching: (1) have Thursday's build in testers' hands, (2) add testers to the Firebase group testers, (3) check the Cloudflare GitHub app still has access to the repo (github.com/settings/installations), (4) paste a GitHub token on the board for the live PR list. Then Settings, General, Danger zone, Change visibility. After: confirm quando.day and board.quando.day still rebuild. Past history and forks stay public. Only on your go.
note: Waiting for your go. Not before Thursday's build is shared.
